$100,000
Explanation:
The house was purchased for $80,000 and $50,000 was spent on repairs. The total cost of the house is $130,000.
The value of the house increased by 150%. This means that the new value of the house is 150% of the original value.
The new value of the house is $130,000 x 1.5 = $195,000.
